description: Idempotency key validation (sections 7.2 and 5.2). Each case passes key as the caller's idempotencyKey: to an ordinary write (method write, for example recordUsage), to withHold, to recordUsageBatch with that many events, or as the key of the one event in a batch (method batchEvent). length is its length in Unicode code points, for reading. outcome is the exact argument error, raised before any request, or valid: the key is sent as given (as Idempotency-Key, or in the event for batchEvent), a withHold excess is recorded under excessKey, and a batch sends its requests in order, each with its number of events and its Idempotency-Key, where null is a new UUID v4 of that request's own.

cases.name: length-1
cases.why: One character is the shortest key.

cases.name: length-200
cases.why: Two hundred characters is the longest key.

cases.name: length-201
cases.why: Two hundred and one characters is too long.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: empty
cases.why: An empty key is refused rather than treated as absent.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: uuid
cases.why: A UUID, the form the SDK generates, is valid.

cases.name: inner-space
cases.why: A space inside the key is printable ASCII and valid.

cases.name: leading-space
cases.why: A key may not start with a space.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: trailing-space

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: single-space

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: only-spaces

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: tab
cases.why: A tab is a control character.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: line-feed

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: nul

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: del

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: non-ascii-accent

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: non-ascii-emoji
cases.why: Emoji are refused.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: non-breaking-space

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: c1-control
cases.why: 0x80 is outside ASCII.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: printable-punctuation
cases.why: Every ASCII punctuation character is printable and valid.

cases.name: printable-ascii
cases.why: Every printable ASCII character other than the space is valid.

cases.name: tilde-and-exclamation-edges
cases.why: A key may start and end with any printable character other than the space, here ~ (0x7E, the top of the range) and ! (0x21).

cases.name: with-hold-leading-space

cases.name: batch-key-length-1

cases.name: batch-key-length-190

cases.name: batch-key-length-191
cases.why: A batch key of 191 characters fails with the batch's own message.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 190 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: batch-key-length-200

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 190 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: batch-key-leading-space

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 190 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: batch-key-trailing-space

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 190 printable ASCII characters.

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 190 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: batch-key-non-ascii

cases.name: batch-event-key-length-200

cases.name: batch-event-key-length-201

outcome.message: Pass idempotencyKey as 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters.

cases.name: batch-500-events-one-request
cases.why: Five hundred events fit in one request, which sends the batch key plus :0.

cases.name: batch-501-events-two-requests
cases.why: The 501st event starts a second request, which sends the batch key plus :1.

cases.name: batch-1001-events-three-requests
cases.why: Requests are counted from 0, so 1,001 events send the keys k:0, k:1 and k:2.

cases.name: batch-1001-events-without-key
cases.why: Without a batch key each request sends a new UUID v4 of its own, shown as null.
